Metadata.title: Creative AI — From Product Photo to Campaign
Metadata.description: An AI creative platform that turns jewelry, fashion and cosmetics products into realistic campaign visuals and short-form videos.

Hero.description: Upload your product, describe your campaign and create realistic visuals and short-form videos while preserving every product detail.

ModelEcosystem.description: We bring together specialized models for imagery, video and product analysis inside one platform.

HowItWorksSection.heading: Create in three steps.
HowItWorksSection.description: Describe the creative direction, upload your product and generate campaign-ready image or video outputs.

idea.title: Describe your idea
idea.description: Describe the scene, model and creative direction you want for your product in natural language.
idea.label: CREATIVE PROMPT
idea.prompt: Show the cobalt-blue jacket in a modern studio shoot with strong shadows.
idea.response: The creative direction is ready. Add your product image to begin.

product.title: Upload your product
product.description: Upload a clean studio shot so its color, cut and material details can be preserved throughout generation.
product.studioAlt: Cobalt-blue cropped jacket shown alone on a neutral studio background
product.outputAlt: Model wearing the cobalt-blue jacket in modern concrete architecture

video.title: Bring the visual to life
video.description: Turn the same creative direction into a campaign visual and short-form video output.
video.label: Short Video
video.posterAlt: Video preview frame of a model walking on steps in the cobalt-blue jacket

WorkspaceDemo.workspaceLabel: Interactive Creative AI campaign workspace demo
WorkspaceDemo.selectProject: Change the sample campaign. Active campaign: {project}

liveStatus.complete: The demo campaign layout is ready.

prompts.jewelry: Turn the organic gold ring into a quiet-luxury launch campaign with warm stone textures and close-up hand photography.
prompts.fashion: Make the cobalt-blue jacket the focus of the new collection through bold architecture and modern editorial photography.
prompts.cosmetics: Create a warm launch for the amber serum bottle using travertine, water reflections and natural skin texture.

jewelry.default: I built a calm launch set from the product input through a model close-up, metal macro, horizontal campaign hero, vertical social image and short-video preview.
jewelry.updated: I applied your direction across six distinct jewelry outputs. The product-led close-up, macro, hero, social and short-video preview are selectable on the canvas.

fashion.default: I turned the raw garment into an editorial set with a full-body model, fabric detail, horizontal campaign hero, vertical social image and short-video preview.
fashion.updated: I applied your direction across six distinct fashion outputs. The jacket’s color and structure stay consistent across the model, detail, hero, social and short-video preview.

cosmetics.default: I expanded the raw product into a warm launch set with a product hero, texture macro, model usage, vertical social image and short-video preview.
cosmetics.updated: I applied your direction across six distinct cosmetics outputs. The bottle form stays consistent across the hero, macro, usage, social and short-video preview.
